permission.owner: current_user pinned-owner active nonrevoked unexpired AuthSession; admin_user requires actual versioned management grant when enabled; legacy is_admin is not authority
permission.csrf: MainSiteSecurityMiddleware host/origin checks; same-origin JSON cookie writes allowed without Origin; cross-origin Origin or foreign Referer / cross-site Fetch rejected, not a CSRF token promise

400: 父监控最多 12 个子项
known_errors.403: pinned-owner/management policy denial or unsafe Origin boundary
known_errors.422: typed path or MonitorCreate request validation; actual main shared loc/type/msg redaction
known_errors.503: trusted origin or auth/admin configuration unavailable (controlled dependency/middleware)

semantics.request: reuse exact MonitorCreate; do NOT invent enum/minimum restrictions absent from source
semantics.transaction: lock -> group/count/source -> monitor+membership -> bump_monitors_version commits both; no POST idempotency guarantee
semantics.unknown_response: client pendingCreation must only GET on retry, no second POST
semantics.automatic_patch: current actual route maps protected field ValueError to 404, not guessed 400/409; name edit remains 200
semantics.empty_group: automatic only allows 0/1; unknown health when empty; manual still 2..12 service constraint

limitations: Read-only bounded source approval, not deployment/global gate approval.
Runtime TestClient uses SQLite and explicit fixture identities; not PG/auth lifecycle verification.
Original rejection receipts remain historical failures; no notification incomplete or unrelated range rewrites.
